chapter: Style, peers and the 1963 New Orleans scene
title: Present-day bands: Celestin's band, Alvin Alcorn and Kid Howard
summary: They discuss who now leads Celestin's band, trumpeters in Paul Barbarin's and other bands, the Jazz Club concerts and a George Boyd brass band record.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel
